title: Ask
emptyMessage: Ask about prices, RSI, pumps, or markets. Answers use live tools when available.
thinking: Thinking… (local AI can take 1–3 min on first reply)
unavailable: Assistant is off. Start the AI service on :8090 (see ai/README) with Ollama or Grok, then retry.
upstreamError: Assistant cannot reach the LLM. Ensure the AI service is running on :8090 and Ollama (local) or XAI_API_KEY (Grok) is configured.
llmNotReady: No LLM available. Install/start Ollama (ollama pull llama3.2) or set AI_LLM_PROVIDER=grok and XAI_API_KEY.
disclaimer: Informational only — not financial advice. Market numbers should come from tools.
